newsitem.title: USA: World War Two vet kills WW One vet in nursing home.
newsitem.headline: World War Two vet kills WW One vet in nursing home.

text.p: A 77-year-old Second World War veteran was charged with second-degree murder in the beating death of a 100-year-old First World War vet in a veterans hospital, a newspaper said on Wednesday.
Charlie Boyd, 77, was indicted by a federal grand jury on Tuesday for fatally beating George Beaty, 100, with a walker on Jan. 3 in the Veterans Affairs Medical Centre in Durham, North Carolina.

A local newspaper said Boyd had been trying to sleep and became angry that Beaty, who lived across the hall, kept making noise. So Boyd got up, took an aluminum walker to Beaty's room and struck him on the head two or three times, The Charlotte Observer said in Wednesday's edition.
Beaty suffered head injuries and died the next day.

Boyd, who had been moved to the medical center's nursing home unit from its psychiatric unit, was undergoing an evaluation to determine whether he is fit to stand trial. An arraignment has not yet been scheduled, the newspaper said.
